text: Make the widgets please and I want to do 100 push ups daily, i need the counter to go 10 by 10 instead of 1 by 1.
author: William Marrero
developer_reply:
Thanks a lot for your feedback! 🙌
Widgets are definitely on my roadmap, and I understand how useful they would be for quick access. I’ll also be adding a custom counter step in the next release so you can adjust it (like 10 by 10) to match your push-up routine.
